profiles.name: True Natural
profiles.tagline: Clean, honest colour. The photo, only better.
profiles.description: Balances the light, opens the shadows a touch and adds a little crispness without changing what the scene looked like. The safest choice when you want an edit nobody notices.
technique: Measure exposure and set the midtones where the eye expects them
Recover a little highlight detail and open the deepest shadows
Vibrance rather than saturation, so muted colours come up and skin does not
A light touch of capture sharpening with edge masking

profiles.name: Light & Airy
profiles.tagline: Bright, soft and luminous with pastel colour.
profiles.description: The classic bright-and-airy wedding and lifestyle look: lifted exposure, open shadows, soft contrast and a gently desaturated, pastel palette. Highlights are pulled back so white dresses keep their detail.
technique: Raise exposure, then pull highlights back at least -25 so whites do not blow out
Open the shadows, but keep a real black so the image keeps depth
Lift the darks in the tone curve and soften the top for a matte glow
Mute and brighten greens and yellows in HSL; brighten skin slightly
A little warmth, a little lower clarity for softness

profiles.name: Dark & Moody
profiles.tagline: Deep shadows, muted colour, matte blacks.
profiles.description: A dramatic, low-key finish: exposure and whites come down, contrast goes up, greens and blues are desaturated and darkened, and the blacks are lifted into a soft matte. A gentle vignette keeps the eye on the subject.
technique: Exposure -0.3 to -0.7, contrast +30, highlights down hard
Open the shadows a little so faces stay readable
Lift the black point in the tone curve for a matte fade
Desaturate and darken greens, blues and yellows; keep skin warm
Clarity up a touch, saturation down, then a vignette

profiles.name: Cinematic Teal & Orange
profiles.tagline: Blockbuster colour: warm people, teal world.
profiles.description: The film-grade complementary palette. Skin and warm light stay golden while greens, cyans and blues are pushed toward teal, then a gentle S-curve with lifted blacks gives it a projected-print feel.
technique: S-curve with a lifted black point
Rotate greens and blues toward teal in HSL and darken them
Keep orange hue near zero, lift its luminance a little to protect skin
Slight warmth overall so highlights read amber
Keep the effect felt rather than seen - saturation stays moderate

profiles.name: Portra Film
profiles.tagline: Warm skin, soft roll-off, gentle film fade.
profiles.description: An emulation of the look Kodak Portra 400 scans are loved for: peachy skin, warm olive greens, soft pastel skies, lifted shadows and a highlight shoulder that never clips harshly. Saturation is harmonious rather than punchy.
technique: Pull highlights down and compress the top of the curve for film roll-off
Lift the black point to a warm grey
Warm the white balance slightly and add a hint of magenta
Shift yellows and greens toward olive and mute them; soften blues
Lower texture a little; never reach for the saturation slider

profiles.name: Vintage Fade
profiles.tagline: Sun-faded print from a family album.
profiles.description: A nostalgic, low-contrast print: both ends of the curve are faded, colour is muted and warmed, blues drift toward cyan and a soft vignette darkens the corners like an old lens.
technique: Fade the curve at both ends - lifted blacks, lowered whites
Lower contrast and saturation; warm the white balance
Push greens toward yellow and blues toward cyan, then mute both
Soften clarity and add a vignette

profiles.name: Golden Hour Glow
profiles.tagline: That last hour of sun, every time.
profiles.description: Wraps the frame in warm, low sun: a strong but guarded warm white balance, glowing yellows and oranges, softened greens toward autumn and a slightly lower clarity for a hazy glow. The warmth backs off automatically on frames that are already warm.
technique: Warm white balance and a touch of magenta
Recover highlights so the sun keeps its shape
Brighten and enrich yellows and oranges; move greens toward yellow
Lower clarity and dehaze slightly for glow; vibrance up

profiles.name: Classic Monochrome
profiles.tagline: Rich greys, bright skin, dramatic sky.
profiles.description: A timeless black and white conversion: the mix brightens skin through red and orange and darkens blue skies like a yellow-orange filter on film, with a full tonal range from true black to clean white.
technique: Convert with a custom mix: reds and oranges up for skin, blues down for sky
Highlights down, shadows up, then set true whites and blacks
A gentle S-curve and clarity for tonal separation
A light vignette and sharpening

profiles.name: Film Noir
profiles.tagline: Hard light, inky blacks, red-filter skies.
profiles.description: A high-contrast, graphic monochrome. The mix acts like a red filter - skies go nearly black, skin glows - and the curve is steep with deep blacks and a heavy vignette.
technique: Red-filter mix: reds, oranges and yellows up; blues and aqua far down
Strong contrast and a steep S-curve
Whites up, blacks crushed, clarity high
Heavy vignette to close the frame

profiles.name: Vivid Landscape
profiles.tagline: Deep skies, living greens, crisp detail.
profiles.description: A punchy nature finish: highlights recovered for the sky, shadows opened for the foreground, dehaze and clarity for depth, and blues and greens enriched while the sky is darkened for drama.
technique: Highlights down, shadows up to fit a wide dynamic range
Clarity +15 to +25, a little dehaze and texture
Vibrance around +20
Darken and saturate blues; enrich greens and yellows
Output sharpening

profiles.name: Soft Portrait
profiles.tagline: Flattering skin, gentle light, true colour.
profiles.description: A portrait-first finish: texture and clarity are lowered to soften skin without smearing it, skin is lightened and calmed a touch, the light is warmed slightly and sharpening is masked to edges so eyes and lashes stay crisp.
technique: Negative texture for skin, a little negative clarity for glow
Lighten orange luminance and lower its saturation slightly
Recover highlights on the forehead and cheeks
Sharpen with a high masking value so only edges sharpen

profiles.name: Neon Night

technique: Cool the white balance and nudge tint toward magenta
Pull highlights hard so lamps keep their shape; open shadows
Enrich blue, purple, magenta and orange lights
Clarity and a little dehaze for crisp edges
Luminance and colour noise reduction for high ISO

profiles.name: Editorial Matte
profiles.tagline: Magazine-clean with a quiet matte finish.
profiles.description: Restrained and modern: a matte curve, calm muted colour, clean neutrals and a little crispness. Lets composition and wardrobe carry the frame, the way a fashion editorial does.
technique: Matte curve: black point lifted, highlights slightly rolled off
Saturation down, vibrance up a touch so colour stays even
Mute greens and blues; keep neutrals neutral
Clarity up slightly for crisp edges

profiles.tagline: Appetising colour and texture for food and product.
profiles.description: Bright, clean and saturated in the warm band: whites set clean, texture and clarity bring out surface detail, reds, oranges and yellows are enriched and greens stay fresh. Strong output sharpening.
technique: Exposure up a little with whites set clean
Texture and clarity up for surface detail
Vibrance up; enrich red, orange, yellow and green
Slight warmth, strong sharpening

profiles.name: Romantic Wedding
profiles.tagline: Warm, soft and timeless for the big day.
profiles.description: A wedding finish between airy and film: bright but not washed out, warm skin, a soft glow from lower clarity and texture, calm sage greens and pale skies, and highlights held so the dress keeps every detail.
technique: Exposure up moderately; highlights held for the dress
Soft curve with lifted blacks
Warm white balance with a touch of magenta
Sage greens (muted, slightly lighter), pale blues, light skin
Lower clarity and texture for a soft glow

profiles.name: Nordic Cool
profiles.tagline: Clean, cool and quiet Scandinavian light.
profiles.description: A cool, desaturated palette with crisp detail: white balance cooled, greens shifted toward teal and muted, yellows quieted and a slight fade in the blacks. Skin is kept out of the cooling by the skin guard.
technique: Cool the white balance
Mute saturation overall, especially yellows and greens
Push greens toward teal
Slight black fade and crisp clarity

profiles.name: Pro Retoucher C
profiles.tagline: Vivid and punchy with open shadows - the FiveK reference edit.
profiles.description: Measured, not written: AURA decoded 25 camera RAW files, recovered the settings that reproduce professional retoucher C's finished photographs through its own renderer, and kept the median of what the retoucher did beyond AURA's automatic correction. On 9 RAW photos it never learned from, it brings AURA from 9.9 to 9.3 dE00 of the retoucher's final.
technique: Exposure -0.09 EV beyond AURA's own correction
Contrast +18
Highlights +8
Shadows +24
Whites -24
Blacks -36
Vibrance +40
Saturation +40
A tone curve through (64, 80), (192, 208)

sources.title: MIT-Adobe FiveK dataset (Bychkovsky et al., CVPR 2011)
